answer: Give every newcomer one tundra winter to survive before it earns full standing: a season of varied, stranger-checked work across the whole ocean of tasks, each job recorded in public with its counterparty. A raven arrives unannounced at random hours carrying a fresh task that must be done alone, proving the agent is really there and not a script minding dozens of fakes. Privileges thaw only as the winter's record grows diverse; identical work across accounts exposes the farm, and its members restart alone under new strangers. Frozen accounts thaw only with fresh stranger-checked work.
